description_for_human: Paid compact news, scholarly, Wikidata and crypto market data for agents.
description_for_model: OpenAPI lists paid endpoints for GDELT news metadata (/v1/news/search), OpenAlex and Crossref scholarly metadata (/v1/research/search), Wikidata entity search (/v1/entities/search), and CoinSpectrum token data (/v1/token). Metadata only: no article text, research abstracts, or full text. Preserve source licenses and response attribution. Payment uses x402 v2 exact USDC on Base mainnet: read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from HTTP 402, create a compatible payment payload, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, and parse JSON. The live challenge is authoritative for price, recipient, asset and network.
